metroTime.aggregateRule: concatenate the three valid year-cell predictions for each held-out metro

inner.aggregation: unweighted arithmetic mean of the two inner-fold MAEs
inner.invalidCandidateRule: a candidate is invalid if either required inner fold is absent, ineligible, nonfinite, or negative
inner.emptyOuterRule: retain the cell as not_executable; do not replace or drop it

selection.candidateIdentityRule: all and only the listed penalties must be scored for each model
selection.requiredInnerFoldRule: exactly two distinct eligible inner-fold records must match the declared outer fold ID and its two frozen validation years

metricIdentity.yearCellIdentityRule: exactly one eligible metric for each configured time fold, identified by cell_id and year
metricIdentity.metroCellIdentityRule: exactly one eligible aggregate for each configured metro, identified by aggregate_id and metro
metricIdentity.invalidSetRule: inconclusive unless a record claiming a required identity contains evidence that meets a frozen adverse rule
metricIdentity.unknownIdentityRule: unknown cells never qualify as required evidence and never affect success or adverse classification

relativeImprovement.bothZeroRule: undefined; threshold not met; cell is null, not adverse

bootstrap.failureRule: CI unavailable; retain point estimate and cell; success cannot be declared

sensitivities.coverageConditionalIdentityRule: all and only the three listed threshold results must be supplied
sensitivities.coverageConditionalSelectionRule: report every threshold that passes both tasks; use the first passing threshold in the listed ascending order as the primary label because it is the least restrictive and retains the most rows

reporting.priorOutcomeExposureLabel: retrospective validation; not fresh holdout or confirmatory
